request.question: How do I request a pooja or spiritual service?
request.answer: Choose a listed service and send your preferred date and details, or book an appointment to discuss your needs. Our team will contact you to review availability and arrangements.

choose.question: Can I ask for help choosing a ceremony?
choose.answer: Yes. Request an appointment and share a little about your occasion. The team can explain the available options and the details needed to plan the next step.

availability.question: Where are services available?
availability.answer: The centre is based in {{city}}. Service availability depends on the ceremony, location, date, and schedule; contact the team to confirm what can be arranged for you.

followUp.question: What happens after I submit a request?
followUp.answer: A request is not a confirmed booking. The team will follow up to discuss availability, ceremony details, and any preparation before confirming the arrangements.

about.title: Bringing families and Vedic pandits together
about.intro: We help families arrange meaningful Hindu ceremonies with experienced pandits. From choosing a ritual to understanding how it is performed, our aim is to make the process welcoming, clear, and rooted in tradition.
about.roleDescription: A pandit helps a family prepare for and participate in a ceremony, while guiding its prayers and traditions. The exact procedure depends on the ritual and family customs.

prepare.title: Prepare according to tradition
prepare.description: Pandits guide families on the ceremony, the sankalp details to prepare, and the materials needed for the chosen ritual.

conduct.title: Conduct the ceremony
conduct.description: They lead the puja, havan, mantra recitation, and key rites in a clear and respectful manner, following the appropriate Vedic paddhati.

include.title: Guide and include the family
include.description: The pandit explains each step, helps participants take part in the rituals, and offers guidance throughout the ceremony.

experience.title: Bring experience and care
experience.description: Our platform shares each pandit’s experience, languages, biography, and specializations so families can understand their background.

about.experienceTitle: A thoughtful experience for every family
about.experienceDescription: Families can browse ceremony information, review available pandit profiles and specializations, and share their preferred arrangements. Our team helps coordinate the details so devotees can focus on the occasion and its meaning.
